source.standard_website_license_note: The SALI website separately describes CC BY-ND. This package provides an author-created crosswalk and compact verbatim source records; it does not alter or republish the ontology as a competing standard.

relationship_definitions.exact: Same subject concept; would still not establish equivalence to a local risk rule. None claimed here.
relationship_definitions.broader: SALI topic is broader than the local issue concept.
relationship_definitions.related: Useful context or retrieval relationship; neither equivalence nor asserted subsumption.
relationship_definitions.unmapped: No adequate concept identified in this pinned source; local rule is retained.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: Five-year survival, the three-year fallback and the disclosure-window distinction are local policy tests; the SALI tag identifies the broader clause topic.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: Area-of-law and clause-topic tags do not encode duration while information remains a qualifying trade secret or decide whether a fixed cap is acceptable.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: No exact residual-memory NDA exception concept was identified in the pinned source. Use the broader confidentiality topic and preserve RESIDUALS as a local rule.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The confidentiality topic is broader than an evaluation-only use restriction. The privacy-specific Purpose Specification Principle was not substituted for a commercial NDA use rule.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: Machine Learning supplies technical context, not permission to train on confidential data. Separate express approval and shared-model scope remain local policy fields.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The definition and disclosure topic do not encode need-to-know access, equivalent duties, professional-duty carveouts or recipient responsibility.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The common disclosure topic does not distinguish lawful notice and cooperation from a prohibited notice obligation. Keep this rule separate from compelled scope.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The common disclosure topic does not encode the minimum-legally-required production limit. Two distinct local rules intentionally share one SALI concept.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: This is an operational preservation topic, not an NDA return/destruction clause equivalent. Thirty-day timing, inactive backup and legal-retention exceptions remain local policy. A hold suspends deletion; it does not authorize disclosure.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: These tags cover examples of the rule, not its full scope: no-hire, IP transfer and other commercial commitments need their own analysis. The instance mapping retains the actual noncompete context.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: No exact source-completeness or missing-incorporated-contract-source concept was identified. Do not use the SALI Attachment concept: its definition concerns prejudgment seizure, not a missing contract attachment. Keep NEED_SOURCE as local workflow state.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The SALI concept describes a broader attack domain. It is not an exact indirect prompt-injection or contract-review rule; instruction isolation and the human gate remain local controls.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: The broad topic is liability allocation. A Limitation of Liability Clause is not an exact match for an express unlimited obligation; lack of a cap alone is not a defect under this policy.

rule_type_mappings.relationship_scope: subject-matter mapping; not equivalence to policy test, severity or approval
rule_type_mappings.gap_note: These tags support privacy routing and retrieval. They do not determine whether a DPA is required, whether processing is authorized or whether a privacy review has occurred.
